page.notes: Doubtful readings: "rv" (the Roman numeral for four, printed small, marked [?]); "Hunefiu" in the text and "Hunefiu fluvius" in the margin, where the last letter could be an s (marked as read). The hyphenated margin note "Agrũ fe-eantes." runs over a line end. Catchword "deriva-" is the last word of the page's text and is not repeated in the paragraph. Signature "A 3" is at the foot.
